subject: ss-general-medicine
title: Basic and clinical immunology: key pathways, cytokines and regulation

steps.tx: The **innate immune system** responds within minutes to hours and uses pattern recognition receptors such as **Toll-like receptors** to detect microbial structures. Signalling through the adaptor IRAK-4 and NF-kappaB drives inflammatory cytokine release. Most TLR and IL-1 receptor pathways depend on IRAK-4, but TLR3 signalling remains intact in IRAK-4 deficiency, a point often tested in exams.

steps.tx: **Cytokines** are classified by function. Pro-inflammatory cytokines such as **IL-1**, **IL-6**, **IL-17** and **IL-18** drive acute-phase responses, fever and neutrophilia. Regulatory cytokines such as **IL-10**, IL-37 and IL-38 suppress excessive inflammation. IL-1 paired with its receptor antagonist is the classic prototype of this balance. Pleiotropy means one cytokine acts on many cell types.

steps.tx: **Regulatory T cells** depend on **IL-2** for survival, and IL-2 also drives effector T-cell proliferation. Loss of Treg function or impaired immune tolerance underlies many autoimmune states. Gain-of-function **STAT3** variants reduce Treg numbers and cause early-onset autoimmunity, whereas loss-of-function STAT3 variants impair **Th17** differentiation. **T helper subsets** are defined by their signature cytokines and transcription factors.

steps.tx: **NEMO** (IKBKG) deficiency causes **X-linked** anhidrotic ectodermal dysplasia with immunodeficiency. Ectodermal features are developmental and persist even after successful haematopoietic stem cell transplantation. Patients are prone to pyogenic bacteria, mycobacteria and opportunistic fungi. Management includes **immunoglobulin replacement** where antibody responses are poor, and antimicrobial prophylaxis. **Live attenuated vaccines**, particularly BCG, must be avoided because of disseminated disease risk.

steps.tx: **Eosinophils** cause tissue damage mainly through granule proteins released after degranulation. **Major basic protein (MBP)** increases membrane permeability by disrupting the lipid bilayer. **IL-5** promotes eosinophil maturation and granule protein synthesis. MBP antagonises inhibitory M2 muscarinic receptors, enhancing bronchial hyperreactivity in asthma. Sputum MBP can identify asthma more sensitively than eosinophil counts alone, and tissue damage can occur even when few intact eosinophils remain.

steps.tx: **Targeted biologics** block specific cytokines. **Tocilizumab** blocks the IL-6 receptor and is used in rheumatoid arthritis and in severe COVID-19 requiring mechanical ventilation on systemic corticosteroids. **Anakinra** blocks IL-1. **Secukinumab** targets IL-17 and raises the risk of tuberculosis and herpes zoster reactivation. **High-dose IL-2** is an established immunotherapy for metastatic renal cell carcinoma and melanoma despite significant toxicity.
